notes.title: Chinese translation added
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I'm just making a quick announcement to let you all know that Criminal Cat has been translated into Simplified Chinese, thanks to the efforts of Soren!

This new build of the game adds a full translation and fixes up a couple of typos present in the English script.

As always, please let me know if you find any bugs/typos in the new build, and I will try to fix them within a reasonable timeframe. Thank you very much!

I also put the game on a discount to celebrate the new translation. I hope that more people will be able to enjoy the story!

- ebi x

notes.title: Beneath the Bleeding Moon has been released!
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

I'm making an announcement to let you know that Beneath the Bleeding Moon has (finally) been released!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/70b21da0c6eb39cb7c621a16a085042789719102.png

I first showed off the demo of this VN 2 years ago, so getting it across the finish line was a bit of a challenge haha ;; I persevered, however, and now the full visual novel is out!

Bleeding Moon is a historical boys' love visual novel set in Japan. Follow Haru, a cross-dressing young man, as he goes on a journey with the devious thief, Kishou, to break an ancient curse.

Bleeding Moon is a little different from my usual visual novels in that it's less of a character drama and more of an adventure story. There's quite a few fight scenes, and it's (generally) light-hearted in tone, though there are a few darker moments.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/58a3b3f6c751b8dc76294c111b49a75b8e9c367a.png

There's also an r18 patch for anybody who wants it, which adds about 20k more words to the story and several animated(!!!) r18 scenes. This is the first time I've added animated adult CGs into any of my VNs, so I hope people enjoy it.

You can check the VN out here if you're curious:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2553080

Thank you for all of your support over the years! It's appreciated! I'll keep working hard to make more visual novels that people will enjoy!

- ebi x

notes.title: How to Melt a Maiden's Heart has been released! \o/
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm writing a post to let you know that my newest BL VN, How to Melt a Maiden's Heart (or Melty Heart for short), has been released! Yay \o/

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/efbfe94f60616a4bb726cfa3fa288e2246e53e46.png

Melty Heart is a cute slice of life story set on the fictional Japanese island of Omorishima (whose name might ring a bell if you've read my earlier yuri VN, My Dear Prince. The VNs take place on the same island and there's a couple of references to MDP in Melty Heart.)

The story centers around Reo, a delinquent who doesn't care about his grades, or his appearance, or school in general, and Yuuma, the serious head of the student council who's always picking fights with Reo. Reo can't stand Yuuma, and the feeling is mutual... But this changes when Reo discovers, quite by accident, that Yuuma has been working part-time at a local café while dressing as a maid.

Reo uses this knowledge to his advantage, and decides to blackmail Yuuma. He coerces Yuuma into helping him with his Love Quest to win over his childhood friend, Chinami. Reo's sure, with Yuuma's help, Chinami will finally fall for him, and they'll be able to live happily ever after...

So why does Reo keep thinking about Yuuma, damn it?!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/3280d29ca52b8266170dfe821c52a4c040c276fc.png

This VN is suitable for all ages and doesn't contain any sexual content or anything particularly fanservicey, apart from a brief scene of Reo in the bath. There's some cursing, but nothing too excessive. The VN is available on PC, mac, and linux, and you can check it out here:

[url=]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3096440

As always, I hope you enjoy it, and happy early holidays!

- ebi x

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Just writing a quick post to let you know I've uploaded a new build of the game. The build fixes a handful of typos which were pointed out by very kind readers on my Discord server, fixes one incorrectly placed sprite, and also makes the chronology of the story a little clearer.

I also edited all of Aster's interactions with Angelique, since some people were turned off by how caustic his internal narration is at points. He's still pretty snippy, but it got pared down a little. The story is supposed to be light-hearted and silly, and I don't want it inadvertently upsetting anybody.

As always, let me know if you find more typos or issues, and I will try to fix things in a reasonable amount of time.

- ebi

notes.title: My Confounding Cat is Criminally Cute has been released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone \o/

I’m writing a quick post to let you know that I’ve released a shiny VN, My Confounding Cat is Criminally Cute (that’s such an extra title lmao…)

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/b8127a7a6765fa3002d04ba8d75f0cb067de910a.png

Criminal Cat is a relatively short BL VN without any choices or branches. It follows a grumpy wizard, Aster, who lives a reclusive life deep in the woods and brews potions to get by. Aster is taciturn by nature, and he swears he isn’t lonely! He’s perfectly fine keeping to himself, thank you very much…

Until a black cat tumbles down his chimney one day, throwing his whole life into disarray!

After taking the black cat in, Aster soon discovers this clumsy kitten is no ordinary feline. He is, in actuality, a young man called Blaise, who has been cursed by a witch to assume the form of a cat during the sunlight hours – but why? What did Blaise do to get cursed, and can Aster help him?

It’ll be a huge pain, but Aster will (reluctantly) do his best. He’ll never be able to get rid of Blaise if he can’t, and all Aster really wants is a quiet life. It’s not like he’s going to fall for his catboy companion or anything, right?

…Right?

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/89d5e81952b23d62d10d692eeb78f042ffc53244.png

Criminal Cat is a pretty sweet and light story, and it doesn’t contain any explicit content. The steamiest thing you’ll find here are a handful of kiss scenes (well, how else are you supposed to break a curse?!)

The adorable art is by Ekkoberry,​ who handled the character sprites, CGs, and the UI! I usually work with multiple artists per project, so having one person manage all of the art-related tasks was a pretty new experience for me. I’m really happy with how this VN turned out: I think it looks very cute and cohesive!

Please consider checking the VN out if you're interested! It's not that long, so it's pretty cheap! And, as always, feel free to leave a review to let me know what you think. Reviews are very helpful for small developers such as myself, as they help push my games to more people and can boost discoverability!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2685600

- ebi x
